module: Mission editor UI element (via editorElementHelper) to choose garage zones: "Initial Zones" (where the player can spawn) and "Destination Zones" (where they can get destinations). The zone names are read from `<globalInfoFolder>/garages.sites.json` via gameplay_sites_sitesManager.loadSites. The module returns a constructor: `require('editor/util/zoneSelectorUtil')(element)`.
notes: The `element` is a shared configuration table (fields read: fieldName, globalInfoFolderFieldName, _id; fields written: initialZones, destinationZones, loadedZones, sitesFile, zonesLoaded, caches).
The chosen lists are written into the data container ctd under the keys `<fieldName>_initialZones` and `<fieldName>_destinationZones`.
If the folder is empty, the garages.sites.json file is missing or sitesManager is unavailable, the zone list stays empty and a yellow message is displayed.
The sites file is always named garages.sites.json; the zones are sorted alphabetically.
The quick-lookup sets are cached and rebuilt only when the array size changes.

loadZonesFromSitesFile.desc: Loads the zone names from `<global folder>/garages.sites.json` (only once per file) into element.loadedZones.

ctd.desc: Container data containing the global folder.

setContainer.desc: Reads initialZones/destinationZones from ctd and resets the loading state to force a reload.

draw.desc: Draws the interface: add combos, Select All / Remove All buttons, lists with Remove button, summary. Writes the lists into ctd.

labelFn.desc: Function called with the element to draw its label.

returns.desc: true if a list was modified.
